title: Scanner uninstall request lacks required app permission
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: ordinary nonprivileged Android 9+ install; detect a disposable launchable package with a com.airpush component then tap its scanner row.
expected: The system uninstall confirmation names the detected fixture and allows cancellation or confirmed removal.
observed: ACTION_DELETE uses a package URI but the target-34 app lacks REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES and DELETE_PACKAGES; AOSP maps this action to an uninstaller that rejects such callers before confirmation. Existing merged debug/directRelease manifests confirm the missing permission; runtime not observed.
fix: Declare normal REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES in all scanner-enabled app variants and retain system confirmation; changing only the intent action is insufficient.
test_evidence: Full assigned-source read plus parsed existing merged-manifest permissions and AOSP source gate. Proposed smallest regression: merged permission assertion and real row-to-system-confirmation test with disposable fixture/cancel. No build or tests run; references and boundaries in remaining-support-review.md.

title: Activity-owned adware scan never refreshes after package changes
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: scan a disposable matching fixture; uninstall through Android Settings with AdAway activity/process kept alive; resume scanner and Back/reopen; also install a fixture after an empty scan.
expected: The current installed-package list replaces old results on return/reopen and the empty state reflects current matches.
observed: loadData is scheduled only by the LiveData constructor; one activity-owned ViewModel retains its result; no resume/result/package-change refresh or manual refresh exists. Old detected rows or empty results persist for that activity lifetime.
fix: Add asynchronous model refresh on scanner activation/return or package invalidation; keep dedicated package executor and reject stale scan completion; preserve rows on canceled uninstall.
test_evidence: All four adware sources and scanner layout fully read. Source-confirmed only; proposed smallest regression uses one retained ViewModel and changed package snapshots across resume/reopen plus cancel/rotation controls. No actual uninstall or Android tests run. Independent of SUP-AUD-001 via Settings removal.

title: Allow and Redirect spoken actions disagree with their callbacks
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: bind a neutral DNS log row and inspect accessibility names or use TalkBack; activate each advertised action then repeat with an already-selected list type.
expected: Each icon announces the same allow/redirect/block or remove operation that its click callback performs.
observed: Allow has redirect contentDescription while Redirect has whitelist contentDescription; adapter binds the opposite ListTypes and never updates descriptions. Selected icons switch to removal but retain Add descriptions.
fix: Correct the two XML references and bind state-aware content descriptions for add versus remove actions.
test_evidence: Structured XML/default-string probe confirms both swapped names; full adapter read confirms ListType/listener mismatch. Proposed smallest regression inflates/rebinds a row with recording callback and asserts labels and actions for null/ALLOWED/REDIRECTED/BLOCKED. No UI or TalkBack execution; excluded LogActivity/ViewModel not reviewed.
